notes.title: Robo Miner 2 is in the works!
notes.notes:
Hello fellow Robo Miners!

I am currently working on a sequel to Robo Miner, which will feature a complete new engine (3D), true endless environments and much more

A lot of those things are already done and I publish some ingame videos of the current progress regulary at the [url=https://www.facebook.com/RoboMiner/]Robo Miner Facebook Page[/url] (be sure to follow that page for the latest information) and the videos are also uploaded to [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC1cQ8tKtDwOa3BV2vCH3lIg]my YouTube Channel[/url].

This is the best time to look at Robo Miner 2 and bring in your suggestions and wishes - especially what kind of things you want to see in a sequel

Meanwhile - enjoy some more of the classic Robo Miner if you just want to waste some time

Happy Robo Mining 2019!

notes.title: Fullscreen now available
notes.notes:
As some users wished to be able to play Robo Miner in real Fullscreen Mode, this is now possible.

To switch to Fullscreen Mode, simply press F11 ingame to toggle between "Fullscreen" and "Windowed Mode"

In Fullscreen Mode the game will use your native Screen Resolution. Let me know if you need more control over resolution used in Fullscreen Mode.

The game will store your setting, so the next time you start the game it should've remembered your last mode.

Hopefully this change is in your favour. Happy Mining!

notes.title: WASD available
notes.notes:
With the latest Mini-Update you can either use the Arrow Keys or use WASD to move the robot - all other key bindings are currently unmodified.

In the the future, there will be the option to assign your own key bindings, but this needs a bit more time, so hopefully, this small update will be in your favour if you prefer to use the WASD Keys to move your robot
